So only A could NOT be a sum.

| Volume (cubic units) | |
|---|---|

explanation.text:
The volume ratio is \(\frac{32{,}000\pi}{500\pi} = 64\), so the scale factor is \(\sqrt[3]{64} = 4\). Cylinder B has radius \(4 \cdot 10 = 40\).

For cylinder A: \(\pi(10)^{2}h = 500\pi\), so \(h = 5\). Then \(k\pi = 2\pi(10)^{2} + 2\pi(10)(5) = 300\pi\), so \(k = 300\).

Cylinder B has height \(4 \cdot 5 = 20\): \(n\pi = 2\pi(40)^{2} + 2\pi(40)(20) = 4800\pi\), so \(n = 4800\).

\(n - k = 4800 - 300 = 4500\).

**Answer:** 4500
